From Ukraine to the Middle East, and amid rising global fragmentation, the international system is being reshaped. A realignment of strategic priorities by the Trump administration has prompted Europe to reassess and review its long-held reliance on transatlantic security guarantees. In response, European states are undertaking their most significant rearmament since the Second World War, while expanding capabilities across defence, technology, and economic security. item.title: ASML’s Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography and the Limits of Reverse Engineering in China
item.description: In June, the U.S. Department of Commerce informed the Dutch company ASML that it suspects one of its extreme ultraviolet lithography machines has reached China, an accusation that ASML denied, and for which no supporting evidence has yet been made public. ASML is the sole global producer of the machines capable of making the most advanced microchips.
